notes: Requires the AutoFlow Supplier Foundation app, which depends on AutoFlow and AutoFlow Core. See docs/apps/SupplierFoundation.md.
Interactive: fired by a page action for one record at a time; every published flow on the trigger runs inline in the user's session, one after the other, with the same outputs.
No commits while the flows run. Each record's run (all flows) is one transaction, committed before the next record.
Publish: no trigger-specific checks and no Job Queue entry.
The page action is shown only while at least one flow is published on the trigger.
Outputs marked 'only when …' are not set when the condition fails; a {{trigger_<name>}} token for them then stays in the text verbatim.
Re-entrancy guard: a flow that fires its own trigger again is skipped, not recursed into.
